name: MRP declaration
requirement: MRP should be explicitly declared on the package.

name: Net quantity declaration
requirement: Net quantity should be visible with a recognized unit such as g, kg, ml, or L.

name: Manufacturer, packer, or importer
requirement: Manufacturer, packer, or importer identity should be visible.

name: Manufacturing or packing date
requirement: Manufacturing or packing date information should be visible where applicable.

name: Consumer care information
requirement: Consumer care phone, email, or contact information should be visible.
